content.short: USDai, a yield-bearing dollar backed by loans against GPUs and AI compute.
content.description: USD.AI lends to AI infrastructure companies outside the big-fund circle, using GPUs and compute hardware as collateral, and passes the interest to holders of staked USDai. Independent underwriters vet each borrower, reserves and loans are visible on-chain, and a mechanism called QEV gives lenders a faster exit from long-term loans. It holds over $600 million in deposits from about 77,000 users, and is developed by Permian Labs with backing from Dragonfly and Coinbase Ventures.
content.meta: Earn yield from loans to AI builders secured by GPUs with USD.AI's USDai, holding $600M+ from 77,000 users.
